channel_points.adopt_note: Afterwards it can be switched from here. Its icon and its redemption history are lost – neither can be carried over through the API.
channel_points.adopt_question: Delete this reward at Twitch and create it again identically?
channel_points.adopted: „%{title}“ was adopted and can be switched now.
channel_points.all_off_hint: Automatic switching is off. The conditions are kept but do not apply.
channel_points.conditions_hint: Separate several entries with a comma. The title is matched as a substring, the category exactly. If both fields of a row are filled, both must match. An off condition beats every on condition. If everything stays empty, this reward is never switched automatically.
channel_points.empty: No reward known yet. The button above fetches what already exists on the channel.
channel_points.error.adopt_stuck: The reward was deleted at Twitch but could not be created again: %{reason} It is still in the list and „Create at Twitch“ catches up.
channel_points.error.already_ours: This reward already belongs to this system – it does not need adopting.
channel_points.error.already_there: This reward already exists at Twitch.
channel_points.error.forbidden: Twitch denies access. Rewards can only be changed by the app that created them – this one probably comes from the creator dashboard.
channel_points.error.rate_limit: Too many requests to Twitch. Please wait a moment.
channel_points.error.scope_missing: Without the permission „Manage channel point rewards“ Twitch accepts neither changes nor loading. The channel has to be connected again.
channel_points.error.too_many: Twitch does not accept more rewards per channel.
channel_points.error.unauthorized: Twitch rejected the login. The channel has to be connected again.
channel_points.field.per_user: Redemption limit per user per stream
channel_points.field.title: Reward name
channel_points.foreign_hint: Twitch only allows changes by the app that created the reward. This one comes from the creator dashboard: name, cost and colour can only be changed there, and this system cannot switch it at all. „Adopt“ replaces it with an identical one this system may manage.
channel_points.import_hint: Fetches every reward of the channel from Twitch. Conditions already entered are kept.
channel_points.imported: Loaded: %{added} new, %{updated} updated, %{removed} no longer present at Twitch.
channel_points.limits_hint: 0 means no limit. The cooldown may not exceed seven days. Without the switch above none of the three numbers apply – they are kept anyway.
channel_points.local_hint: This reward exists here only – not at Twitch. That happens when creating it failed. „Create at Twitch“ catches up.
channel_points.name: Channel points
channel_points.new_hint: Created at Twitch right away – and therefore one this system may switch. A custom icon cannot be set through the API, it gets the default one.
channel_points.perm.toggle: Turn the automation on and off
channel_points.placeholder.title: e.g. farming, chill
channel_points.remove_question: Remove this reward from the list?
channel_points.removed_here: „%{title}“ was removed from this list. It stays at Twitch.
channel_points.saved_conditions: The conditions for „%{title}“ were saved. The other fields belong to the creator dashboard.
channel_points.saved_local: „%{title}“ was saved here – it does not exist at Twitch yet.
channel_points.scope.why: so rewards can be created and switched on and off depending on stream title and category
channel_points.stream.offline: not running – nothing is being switched.
channel_points.toggle_hint: Switch automatically by title and category
channel_points.turned_off: Automatic switching is off. Rewards can still be changed by hand.
channel_points.why.foreign: This reward was not created by this system – it cannot be switched.
channel_points.why.manual: No conditions entered – this reward is not switched automatically.
channel_points.why.off: Does not match the running stream – it belongs off.
channel_points.why.offline: No stream is running. Everything stays as it is.
channel_points.why.on: Matches the running stream – it belongs on.
